scope: All of the existing MX riding corridor, all jumps, both roller sections and connecting corners; road circuits and physical terrain unchanged.
dirt: Extend the v049 slope-aware furrows, clods, compact crests and churned landings using existing atlases. Remove the two global compaction lanes from packed mask and macro albedo; no continuous authored tyre-line paths.
palette: Exact accepted photographic loose/packed colour and normal tiles, with the accepted earthy palette and matte alpha 2. Macro dirt uses subtle irregular mottling rather than line-based colour.
optimization: The existing 14 terrain layers, 4 m visual depths, tile sizes and single shared 8K atlas pair; no new terrain layers or atlas allocations.
grass: Replace every legacy scrub panel and old botanical grass mesh with double-sided photographic Bermuda blade geometry. Small spatial batches, natural height variation, no grass shadow casting; all accepted trees and other scenery exact.
